The Hoboken rental market

Hoboken is one of the densest, most rental-heavy square miles in New Jersey. Brownstone walk-ups, converted multi-families, and newer luxury mid-rises sit side by side, and PATH, ferry, light rail, and bus service put Manhattan minutes away. For owners that means steady renter demand — but also a fast-moving, price-sensitive market where days-on-market and accurate pricing drive your return more than they would in a quieter suburb.

A large share of Hoboken units are condos governed by an association, and Hoboken is a rent-control municipality. Both shape how a unit is leased, priced, renewed, and maintained — which is exactly where hands-on local management earns its fee.

What Hoboken landlords navigate

Condo and HOA rules, limited off-street parking, tight turnover windows between leases, and the upkeep realities of pre-war construction all raise the operational bar here versus a typical single-family rental. Not sure whether your building falls under rent control? Start with our NJ rent control lookup — then we handle the rest.

Why Hoboken owners work with PPM

We market to Hoboken's competitive renter pool and screen every applicant, coordinate with condo associations and building management, and keep each property aligned with Hoboken and statewide NJ requirements — all under one flat fee, with real-time visibility in your owner portal. One point of accountability, whether you own a single condo or a small portfolio across Hudson County.

Hoboken has rent control.

Annual rent increases on covered buildings are capped by the city’s rent control ordinance, administered by the Hoboken Rent Leveling & Stabilization Board, and covered units must be registered. We keep every increase, notice, and registration compliant — and track the current cap and exemptions for you.
